starting_state: Channel 1 has a MIDI device on OUT 1 with pattern 1 assigned (range steps 1-64), and playback is stopped. The audio input will receive a synthetic test recording, 29 seconds of a short thump on every beat at 120 BPM, once Record starts. Tempo stays on Auto.

steps.caption: Starting point: channel 1 has a MIDI device on OUT 1 with pattern 1 assigned (range steps 1-64) and playback is stopped. Play a steady loop into the norns audio input, with a short thump on every beat at 120 BPM; the example uses a 29-second loop, so use one at least that long. Press Pattern (5,8) and choose the Rhythm Doctor algorithm at (16,2). Rhythm Doctor opens on the norns: Record READY, Tempo AUTO, Manual BPM 120, Input STEREO. The bank is EMPTY, so no lane buttons are lit yet.
Leave Tempo on AUTO and tap Record at (1,2). Doctor starts listening to the audio input and will estimate the tempo and phrase start itself. The screen reads CAPTURE, MORE AUDIO NEEDED, LISTENING.

Let the take run until the screen reads ENOUGH / REC OR K3 (about 25 seconds of the loop; this is real time, so wait for the readout), then press K3. Doctor stops recording and analyses it: ANALYSING, Lanes BD SD CYM.

Wait while the norns analyses the recording; a short take takes roughly half a minute, and this wait cannot be shortened. When it finishes, the Window screen shows READY with Window bar 1, Window step 1, Sensitivity 0 and Paint policy TOGGLE. Window bar moves the view by 16 steps and Window step by one, Sensitivity is set for the selected lane, and Paint policy (Toggle, Add or Replace) decides how painted hits meet trigs already in the pattern. The lane buttons BD (bass drum), SD (snare) and CYM (cymbal) light at (3,2) to (5,2).

Select the BD lane (bass drum) at (3,2) and tap Paint at (16,8). The grid flashes the detected bass-drum hits on steps 10, 14, 18 and so on every fourth step to step 62, one per beat. The first hit is on step 10, not step 1, because Auto estimates the phrase start from the recording and the first thump comes some way into it; a Manual-tempo take of the same loop shows it on step 11. This is only a preview: nothing is stored yet. The screen reads PAINT, Policy TOGGLE, Destination 1.
Press Paint at (16,8) again to commit. The tooltip reads Pattern painted and the flashing steps become solid trigs in pattern 1, on the same steps as the preview. The captured bank stays unchanged.

Press Channel (3,8), then Play at (1,8). Channel 1 sends MIDI note 60 on each painted step at velocities between 123 and 126, taken from the recording, one hit per beat. The frame shows the Masks screen with the pattern stopped; check the MIDI strip below for the notes sent. Press Play again after about three seconds to stop.

title: Record audio in Auto mode and paint detected attacks
